self-host:flocksafety-com.summary: Vulnerability disclosure program covering all Flock products and services, including hardware devices, embedded software and firmware, mobile and web applications, and cloud services. No paid bounty, but valid reports are credited in the advisory and CVE record if the researcher wants. Testing live customer or agency deployments and accessing law enforcement or personal data is not allowed. Reports need a reproducible proof of concept, and summaries of scanner or AI output get closed.
